revisionNote: v4 corpus after the v3 validation failed the determinate-specificity gate 29/39 = 0.744 and the reference-agreement gate 44/54 = 0.815 (run 2026-08-21, archive 83450f09, authorization da548a54). All ten v3 misses were one-directional over-readings the v2 prompt licensed: pace wishes read as effort withdrawal and compliance reports read as productive uptake. v4 pairs a fresh corpus (spent v1, v2, and v3 worlds permanently excluded) with the revised v3 instrument, which narrows effort withdrawal to a public stop of work and productive uptake to a forward-looking inquiry move. Every reference label was confirmed field-by-field by a blind claude-sonnet-5 second reader that saw only the case text and the field definitions; cases with any field-level disagreement were dropped, never relabeled.
